name: M3: Send email from the connected Gmail account (compose, confirm, reply)
description:
MILESTONE 3 — the user can send email as the connected account. Depends on M1; independent of M2 except that both need the scope upgrade, so land the scope handling once.

Profiles chosen: py_senior (send API + MIME construction + scope handling) and VueDeveloper (compose UI).

WHAT TO BUILD:
1. Backend: POST /users/me/gmail/accounts/{id}/messages/send taking to, cc, bcc, subject, body, and optional reply_to message id. Build a correct MIME message (including threading headers for replies) and send via the Gmail API with the gmail.send scope.
2. Consent scope upgrade to include gmail.send; an account that only granted read must be re-consented with a clear message. Do not silently drop the send request.
3. Safety: validate recipient addresses, cap body size, and return the Google message id plus a clear success/failure result. Never retry a send automatically on a network error — report it instead, so the user does not double-send.
4. Frontend: compose panel — to/cc/subject/body, a confirmation step showing exactly what will be sent and to whom, and a success state. A "Reply" action from the M2 message reader pre-fills recipient and subject.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- Sending to the user's own address delivers a real email that arrives in Gmail, with correct subject and body.
- Reply from the reader pre-fills the right recipient and threads correctly.
- A missing send scope produces an actionable "grant send access" prompt, not a generic failure.
- Double-sending is not possible from the UI (button disabled while in flight, explicit result shown).
